&nbsp;Job Position: Operations Manager

Job Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: 9am-5pm WAT

Role Overview


	We are looking for a highly competent, proactive, and results-driven Operations Manager to lead and oversee daily production operations from planning to final delivery.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring production targets are met efficiently, cost-effectively, and on schedule while maintaining high standards of quality, performance, and accountability.
	A strong leader with excellent operational judgment, problem-solving ability, and hands-on experience managing people, processes, timelines, and output in a fast-paced environment.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee end-to-end production activities to ensure smooth daily operations.
	Develop, manage, and execute production schedules based on business priorities and deadlines.
	Ensure production targets, turnaround times, and service levels are consistently achieved.
	Monitor workflow, identify bottlenecks, and implement immediate corrective actions.
	Maintain continuity of operations with minimal downtime or disruption.
	Lead, supervise, and coordinate production staff to ensure productivity and accountability.
	Assign tasks, set clear expectations, and monitor daily performance.
	Conduct regular check-ins, coaching, and performance reviews.
	Build a high-performance culture focused on discipline, ownership, and continuous improvement.
	Support hiring, onboarding, and training of new production team members when required.
	Ensure all output meets approved quality standards, specifications, and client expectations.
	Implement and maintain quality control procedures across all stages of production.
	Address quality issues promptly and drive preventive solutions.
	Ensure compliance with internal policies, operational procedures, and safety standards.
	Analyze workflows, productivity trends, and production data to improve efficiency.
	Introduce systems, tools, and best practices that enhance output and reduce waste.
	Optimize resource allocation including manpower, tools, and materials.
	Drive continuous improvement initiatives across the production function.
	Prepare accurate daily, weekly, and monthly production reports.
	Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution.


Requirements


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Industrial Management, or related field is an advantage.
	2-5 years of experience as a Production Manager, Operations Manager, or similar leadership role.
	Relevant practical experience may be considered in place of formal education.
	Proven experience managing teams, workflows, deadlines, and performance targets.
	Strong track record of improving operational efficiency and delivering measurable results.


Must Have:


	Strong leadership and people management skills.
	Excellent planning, organization, and execution ability.
	Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
	High attention to detail and quality control mindset.
	Strong analytical and reporting skills.
	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
	Proficiency with spreadsheets, reporting tools, and production management systems.
	Self-management, discipline, and accountability in a remote work environment.
	Experience working with US-based teams or managing remote teams (added advantage).


Work Requirements:


	Reliable and functional laptop or PC
	Stable internet connection and consistent power supply.
	Quiet, professional workspace suitable for remote work.


Salary
N300,000 - N500,000 monthly.",

Operations Manager Job at Raphael Group




        
    

        
        Raphael Group is a professional virtual assistant service that connects employers with skilled remote assistants. We offer a wide range of services to support individuals and businesses, including scheduling, email management, research, and more. We take the hassle out of finding and hiring qualified virtual assistants, allowing you to focus on growing your business.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Operations Manager

Job Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: 9am-5pm WAT

Role Overview
     

            
    




	We are looking for a highly competent, proactive, and results-driven Operations Manager to lead and oversee daily production operations from planning to final delivery.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring production targets are met efficiently, cost-effectively, and on schedule while maintaining high standards of quality, performance, and accountability.
	A strong leader with excellent operational judgment, problem-solving ability, and hands-on experience managing people, processes, timelines, and output in a fast-paced environment.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee end-to-end production activities to ensure smooth daily operations.
	Develop, manage, and execute production schedules based on business priorities and deadlines.
	Ensure production targets, turnaround times, and service levels are consistently achieved.
	Monitor workflow, identify bottlenecks, and implement immediate corrective actions.
	Maintain continuity of operations with minimal downtime or disruption.
	Lead, supervise, and coordinate production staff to ensure productivity and accountability.
	Assign tasks, set clear expectations, and monitor daily performance.
	Conduct regular check-ins, coaching, and performance reviews.
	Build a high-performance culture focused on discipline, ownership, and continuous improvement.
	Support hiring, onboarding, and training of new production team members when required.
	Ensure all output meets approved quality standards, specifications, and client expectations.
	Implement and maintain quality control procedures across all stages of production.
	Address quality issues promptly and drive preventive solutions.
	Ensure compliance with internal policies, operational procedures, and safety standards.
	Analyze workflows, productivity trends, and production data to improve efficiency.
	Introduce systems, tools, and best practices that enhance output and reduce waste.
	Optimize resource allocation including manpower, tools, and materials.
	Drive continuous improvement initiatives across the production function.
	Prepare accurate daily, weekly, and monthly production reports.
	Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Industrial Management, or related field is an advantage.
	2-5 years of experience as a Production Manager, Operations Manager, or similar leadership role.
	Relevant practical experience may be considered in place of formal education.
	Proven experience managing teams, workflows, deadlines, and performance targets.
	Strong track record of improving operational efficiency and delivering measurable results.


Must Have:


	Strong leadership and people management skills.
	Excellent planning, organization, and execution ability.
	Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
	High attention to detail and quality control mindset.
	Strong analytical and reporting skills.
	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
	Proficiency with spreadsheets, reporting tools, and production management systems.
	Self-management, discipline, and accountability in a remote work environment.
	Experience working with US-based teams or managing remote teams (added advantage).


Work Requirements:


	Reliable and functional laptop or PC
	Stable internet connection and consistent power supply.
	Quiet, professional workspace suitable for remote work.


Salary
N300,000 - N500,000 monthly.

Assistant General Manager (AGM) Job at Qualis Business Support Services Limited




        
    

        
        Qualis Business Support Services Limited - Our client, a non-profit organization dedicated to the care and support of Orphans and Vulnerable Children, is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Assistant General Manager (AGM)

Job Location: Anthony Village (Lagos Mainland), Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Assistant General Manager to lead and oversee our innovative team, manage project implementation, and drive fundraising efforts to achieve our goal.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for Overseeing the entire day to day operations of the organization and its resources within the agreed budget to realize the goals set out by the Board.


Principal Accountabilities
Financial:


	Supervise timely preparation of budgets and other financial reports by the accountant.
	Carry out fundraising efforts with only highest ethical standard
	Research individuals, corporations, and foundations, strategies and execute fundraising campaigns


Administrative:


	Assist in preparing organization’s plan.
	Assist in the review, recommendation, development and maintenance of existing structures in the organization.


Human Resource:


	Identify human resource needs and fill vacancies not more than a week after position is vacant.


Trainings & induction:


	Scheduling of duties for all staff and supervision


Child Wefare:


	Carry out monthly assessment, review, recommendation and implementation of approved standards for children
	Liaise with Management and external consultant to oversee and monitor implementation of all matters pertaining to adoption and fostering as recommended and approved by management.


Management:


	Quarterly briefing of members
	Bi-Annual briefing of the board


Coordination of Projects and Events:


	Create project management calendars annually
	Maintaining and monitoring project plans, schedules, work hours, budgets, income and expenditure.
	Organizing, attending and participating in stakeholders’ meetings.


Required


	Bachelor’s Degree in Social Works, Business Administration, Education or any related discipline
	5 - 7 years of management experience in a social welfare organisation, children’s home, an educational, non-profit or medical institution required
	Advanced degree, MBA or certifications in child welfare, non-profit management, or similar fields is an advantage
	Experience in fundraising, grant writing, and managing donors ‘relationship
	Strong leadership abilities with a focus on team building and staff development
	Knowledge of legal and regularity frameworks affecting children’s homes in Lagos.


Salary
N500,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their resume to: [email protected] using "AGM" as the subject of the email.

  "description": "Castville Solutions is a recruitment and business solutions provider specializing in the healthcare sector. We focus on connecting healthcare facilities with highly skilled professionals, enabling efficient operations, and driving business growth. Our services extend to recruitment, Templates for process and operations management, SOP development, and healthcare-specific training, with a clear mission to transform the healthcare workforce and operations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Cabinet Design Architect / Designer

Job Location: Lekki-Eke Express way, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Cabinet Design Architect/Designer translates client requirements and architectural drawings into precise, manufacturable cabinet designs.
	This role bridges sales, engineering, and production &mdash; ensuring every design is aesthetically sound, structurally viable, and optimized for CNC manufacturing while meeting material and tolerance standards.


Key Responsibilities
Design &amp; Client Interface:


	Develop cabinet and millwork designs from client briefs, architectural drawings, or interior design concepts (kitchens, wardrobes, wall units, commercial fit-outs)
	Prepare 2D/3D renderings and mood boards to present design concepts to clients for approval
	Conduct or review site measurements to ensure designs fit actual spatial conditions
	Advise clients on material selection, finishes, hardware, and design feasibility within budget.


Technical Drawing &amp; Engineering:


	Produce detailed shop drawings, cut lists, and cabinet schedules using CAD/cabinet design software (e.g., AutoCAD, SketchUp, Mozaik Software, PolyBoard, or similar)
	Ensure all designs comply with the company&#39;s established tolerance standards for MDF and plywood (thickness, squareness, dimensional accuracy)
	Specify joinery methods, fasteners, and assembly techniques appropriate to each design
	Generate CNC-ready nesting files/programs, or hand off accurate specifications to CNC programming staff.


Production Coordination:


	Collaborate with production and quality control teams to confirm designs are manufacturable within current machine capabilities
	Review prototypes/first-run samples against design intent and flag deviations
	Update designs based on production feedback (material waste, assembly difficulty, structural issues)
	Maintain a library of standard cabinet modules, templates, and reusable design components to improve production efficiency.


Cross-Functional &amp; Administrative:


	Work with the sales/CRM team to convert approved quotes into finalized production-ready designs
	Maintain accurate design documentation and revision history in the company&#39;s project management/ERP system
	Support costing/estimation teams with accurate material takeoffs
	Stay current on design trends, hardware innovations, and manufacturing techniques relevant to cabinetry


Qualifications


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree / HND in Architecture, Interior Design, Industrial Design, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
	3+ years of experience in cabinet/furniture design, millwork, or joinery &mdash; CNC manufacturing environment preferred
	Proficiency in CAD software; cabinet-specific design software strongly preferred
	Strong understanding of wood-based panel materials (MDF, plywood, particleboard) and their manufacturing tolerances
	Excellent spatial reasoning and attention to detail
	Ability to read and interpret architectural/interior design drawings.


Key Competencies:


	Precision and quality-mindedness
	Client-facing communication skills
	Collaborative &mdash; comfortable working across design, sales, and shop-floor teams
	Problem-solving under production constraints (cost, material, machine capability).

Laser & Router Machine Operator Job at Grand Stride Limited




        
    

        
        Grand Stride Limited, is a marketing communications company that deals in Outdoor of home advertising, Large Format Printing, Branding and consultancy and has been in business for almost two decades. Our clientele include but not limited to; Nestle nig. Plc., Unilever nig. Plc., Friesland Campina.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Laser & Router Machine Operator

Job Location: Nigeria

Requirements
     

            
    




	SSCE/OND/technical qualification
	2–3 years of practical experience operating laser and CNC router machines.
	Experience working with acrylic, MDF, PVC, plywood, aluminium composite panels, foam board and related materials.
	Ability to interpret production drawings, dimensions and artwork files.
	Knowledge of appropriate machine settings, cutting speeds, power settings and tool selection.
	Familiarity with relevant software such as CorelDRAW, AutoCAD, ArtCAM, Aspire, RDWorks/Ruida or equivalent.
	Ability to perform basic machine maintenance and troubleshoot minor operational problems.
	Good knowledge of workshop safety procedures.
	Excellent measurement accuracy and attention to finishing quality.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a production team.
	Added advantage: Experience in signage fabrication, 3D lettering and illuminated signage.
	All applicants should demonstrate professionalism, integrity, reliability, good communication skills, willingness to learn and the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
	Experience in the outdoor advertising, branding, large-format printing, signage or marketing communications industry will be an advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their applications and CVs to: [email protected] and [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
